coordinate_frame: actor yaw-relative; no map frame fields

groups.definition: Actor-yaw-relative xyz velocity, divided by 12 m/s and clipped.
groups.name: self_velocity_local

groups.definition: Pitch/yaw/roll finite-difference angular velocity, divided by 720 deg/s and clipped.
groups.name: self_angular_velocity_local

groups.definition: Self health, magazine, reserve and cooldown fractions.
groups.name: health_ammo_cooldown

groups.definition: Valid bit, noisy actor-relative damage-bearing sin/cos, clipped cue age.
groups.name: recent_damage_cue

groups.definition: Previous phase5_action8_v1 after environment clipping and binarization.
groups.name: previous_action

groups.definition: Normalized speed/progress, short/long stuck fractions, collision rate and time since progress.
groups.name: progress_stuck_history

groups.definition: 32 yaw-relative 360-degree torso rays as normalized distance/hit-bit pairs; character layers are ignored.
groups.name: torso_obstacle_rays

groups.definition: 16 foot-height and 16 head-height yaw-relative rays as normalized distance/hit-bit pairs; character layers are ignored.
groups.name: foot_head_obstacle_rays

groups.definition: 8 radial probes as normalized floor distance, floor-valid bit and step-obstacle bit triples.
groups.name: floor_drop_step_rays

groups.definition: Most recent controller collision normal transformed to actor-yaw-local space.
groups.name: collision_normal_local

groups.definition: Minimum normalized torso clearance in eight actor-relative sectors.
groups.name: local_free_space_summary

groups.definition: Visible bit, bearing/elevation sin/cos, normalized log distance and actor-local relative velocity xyz. Payload is zero unless LOS is true.
groups.name: visible_enemy_state

groups.definition: Valid bit, stale last-seen point transformed to current actor-local xyz and clipped age. The stored point updates only while LOS is true.
groups.name: last_seen_memory

groups.definition: Valid bit, event-time noisy bearing sin/cos and clipped age. It never follows a hidden target.
groups.name: last_heard_memory

groups.definition: Eight-way noisy bearing one-hot, five-way logarithmic distance one-hot, valid bit, clipped age and last-update dropout bit; at most 2 Hz with dropout.
groups.name: coarse_hunt_cue

groups.definition: One-hot patrol, investigate, combat or recovery mode derived only from allowed actor fields.
groups.name: tactical_mode

local45_compatibility: This is an opt-in parallel sensor. phase3v2_c_local45 and its fitted normalizer are unchanged.

visibility_contract.los_false: visible_enemy_state payload indices are exactly zero; last-seen/heard memories are stale event-time data only
visibility_contract.los_true: visible_enemy_state may contain exact current relative state
